recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if ClinicalAssessment returns to the active core build or if the Patient Care incubator canonical location changes.
issue_request: FHIR-50527 is an Applied/Persuasive OO R6 technical correction asking to add a hyperlink to ClinicalAssessment in the Observation Boundaries and Relationships sentence that already linked Condition but named ClinicalAssessment as plain text.
initial_application: Commit b63d5ae0e9 applied the issue by changing source/observation/observation-introduction.xml so the requested sentence linked ClinicalAssessment to clinicalassessment.html. The combined branch had no prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-50527 before this audit.
additional_context: FHIR-46596 renamed ClinicalImpression to ClinicalAssessment, establishing the referenced name before FHIR-50527. Later commit fad1b9cf84 removed ClinicalAssessment from the active core resource list and retargeted Observation and Resource Guide ClinicalAssessment links to https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/pc-incubator/StructureDefinition-ClinicalAssessment.html. Current source/fhir.ini keeps Observation active but has no active ClinicalAssessment resource entry.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because source/observation/observation-introduction.xml:105 already hyperlinks ClinicalAssessment, and restoring clinicalassessment.html would point at a no-longer-active core page.
